meta.title: Message templates
meta.description: Edit the email, SMS and inbox messages Friends of Animals sends.

adminTemplates.title: Message templates
adminTemplates.lead: The words of every message we send. A saved change applies to the next message, with no new release.

denied.title: Only content managers edit messages
denied.body: Your account doesn't have the content manager role. A super admin can give it to you.

consent.withdrawn: someone withdraws their consent to messages

contact_message.received: someone sends a message through the contact form

adminTemplates.unregistered: Not DLT registered, so not sent

meta.title: Edit a message template
meta.description: Change the words of one message, channel by channel.

editor.notFound: There is no template with that name.
editor.lead: Write plain text. Put a variable in double curly brackets and we fill it in for each person.
editor.subject: Subject
editor.title: Title
editor.dltHint: The id this exact wording is registered under. Changing the wording clears it, and SMS stops until the new wording is registered.
editor.stale: Someone saved a newer version while you were editing. Reload the page to see it, then make your change again.
editor.invalid: Check the message and try again.
editor.previewHint: With sample values, as last saved.

problems.unknown_variable: {name} is not a variable this message can use.
problems.unclosed_placeholder: A variable starts with two curly brackets but never ends.
problems.invalid_placeholder: Only a variable name can go between double curly brackets.
problems.too_long: Make it at most {max, number} characters.
problems.too_long_input: This is too long to save.
problems.not_allowed: This channel doesn't use this field.
problems.invalid: Use the digits of the DLT template id.
